cases.sentence: Вы сможете помыть ноги и переночевать, а ___ продолжите свой путь.
cases.explain: «ранним утром» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

cases.sentence: Лот вышел и сказал своим ___, женихам его дочерей:
cases.explain: «будущим зятьям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

cases.sentence: Он посмотрел на Содом и Гоморру и на всю долину и увидел: ___ поднимается от земли, как дым из печи.
cases.explain: «густой дым» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

cases.sentence: Старшая дочь родила сына и назвала его Моав ; он — отец ___.
cases.explain: «нынешних моавитян» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

cases.sentence: Младшая дочь тоже родила сына и назвала его Бен-Амми ; он — отец ___.
cases.explain: «нынешних аммонитян» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
